health.description: Actor Vidya Malavade recently shared that she has been dealing with what she called an “estrogen belly” over the past two years, while continuing to work hard to maintain her fitness despite running on very little sleep and working night shoots. She noted that chronic sleep deprivation and stress can increase cortisol levels, affect metabolism, and make it harder to manage belly fat even in women who exercise regularly. While a gradual increase in abdominal fat can be a normal part of ageing, women should seek medical advice if it is sudden or accompanied by symptoms such as irregular periods, unexplained weight gain, or fatigue. The healthiest approach, she said, is to focus on strength training, regular physical activity, adequate protein intake, good sleep, stress management, and accepting natural body changes rather than chasing unrealistic ideals.

science.title: Molecular evidence of error rates in field identification of tiger and leopard scats and observer accuracy
science.description: Scat-based diet analysis is widely used in ecological studies to infer predation patterns, trophic relationships, and carrying capacity. However, morphological similarities among sympatric carnivore scats can compromise field identification accuracy, potentially biasing management decisions and conservation outcomes. We assessed field identification accuracy for scats collected from Kanha Tiger Reserve, India, that were putatively identified as tiger Panthera tigris or leopard P. pardus. We evaluated the ability of field experts to identify scats through visual inspection, measured morphometric parameters, and compared field assignments with species identities confirmed by genetic tools. Scats of both species showed overlapping 95% confidence intervals for weight (tiger: 126.32 g, 95% CI: 88.55–164.09 g; leopard: 78.33 g, 95% CI: 60.40–96.26 g) and diameter (tiger: 35.34 mm, 95% CI: 32.11–38.57 mm; leopard: 28.42 mm, 95% CI: 14.55–42.29 mm). Terminal hooks were significantly more prevalent in leopard scats than tiger scats (57% vs. 29%; χ²=9.36, df = 1, p = 0.002), while coiling patterns occurred similarly in both species (86% vs. 94%; χ²=0.5, p = 0.471). Logistic regression identified scat diameter as the only significant predictor of species identity (β = 0.104 ± SE 0.044, p = 0.019), but morphological traits alone could not reliably distinguish scats. Field identification of scats was highly error-prone, with individual observer error rates of ∼33–60% (mean = 46%, SE = 0.01). No significant relationship existed between observer experience and identification accuracy. Our findings demonstrate that visual identification of similarly sized carnivore scats is unreliable, and any inference from such data should be interpreted cautiously. In landscapes with multiple sympatric carnivore species, we strongly recommend genetic methods for definitive species identification from scats.

science.content: नील गेहरेल्स स्विफ्ट स्पेस टेलीस्कोप को 20 नवंबर, 2004 को पृथ्वी की कक्षा में स्थापित किया गया था। यह केवल एक साधारण उपग्रह नहीं है, बल्कि खगोल भौतिकी के क्षेत्र में एक बहुउद्देशीय उपकरण है, जो ब्रह्मांड में सबसे शक्तिशाली विस्फोटों, गामा-किरण विस्फो... [3805 chars]
